description: This PHP class 'UserMigrationService' handles user migration from legacy GoogleSync to CalendarSync system in SuiteCRM, including OAuth connection management, calendar account creation, and disabling legacy sync.

classes.name: UserMigrationService
classes.description: Service class for migrating users from legacy GoogleSync to CalendarSync, managing OAuth connections, calendar accounts, and legacy sync disabling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes DBManager, Logger, and OAuthAuthorizationService instances.

methods.name: validateUserMigrationRequirements
methods.description: Checks for necessary modules and database tables for migration.

methods.name: findAllUsersForMigration
methods.description: Retrieves all users needing migration, both legacy and new.

methods.name: findLegacyGoogleSyncUsers
methods.description: Finds users with legacy Google Calendar sync configuration.

methods.name: getUserBean
methods.description: Fetches user bean by ID with validation.

methods.name: extractLegacyUserData
methods.description: Extracts legacy Google sync data from user preferences.

methods.name: findNewGoogleSyncUsers
methods.description: Finds users with existing Google Calendar accounts in the new system.

methods.name: migrateUser
methods.description: Performs migration of a user, creating OAuth connection and calendar account, disabling legacy sync.

methods.name: hasNewGoogleCalendarAccount
methods.description: Checks if user already has a Google Calendar account in the new system.

methods.name: createOAuthConnection
methods.description: Creates and validates OAuth connection for user.

methods.name: validateAndRefreshOAuthConnection
methods.description: Validates OAuth token and refreshes if expired.

methods.name: createCalendarAccount
methods.description: Creates calendar account linked to OAuth connection.

methods.name: disableLegacySync
methods.description: Disables legacy Google sync preferences for user.

methods.name: createEmptyUserData
methods.description: Creates empty user data object for new sync users.

methods.name: createOAuthBean
methods.description: Creates OAuth connection bean with validation.

methods.name: createCalendarBean
methods.description: Creates calendar account bean with validation.
